webhook.title: CallVarta / CRM webhook
webhook.intro: While on, every document that finishes analysis sends its applicant's file-check verdict to your CRM as a signed HTTPS POST (event file_check.completed), and logging a file in with a lender under Eligibility & lenders sends event file_login.requested.
webhook.urlHint: HTTPS only, port 443 (default) or 8443, a public host, no user:password@. Leave empty to remove the webhook.
webhook.urlNotHttps: The URL must start with https:// – the server refuses it otherwise.
webhook.enabledHint: Off: nothing is sent. On needs a URL and a signing secret.

verify.title: How CallVarta CRM verifies it
verify.intro: Each delivery is an HTTPS POST with a JSON body and these headers:
verify.steps: CallVarta CRM recomputes HMAC-SHA256 with the shared secret (UTF-8) over the timestamp t, a dot and the raw request body, compares the hex digest with v1 in constant time, and rejects a timestamp more than 5 minutes from its clock. Retries keep the same X-DocAI-Delivery id, so a repeated delivery can be ignored.
